# Skill: debug

Systematic debugging skill.

1. Reproduce the failure (run_python or run_shell).
2. Form a clear hypothesis.
3. Add minimal instrumentation or assertions.
4. Locate the root cause (not the symptom) using read_file / search_files.
5. Apply the smallest correct fix with write_file.
6. Re-run to verify.
7. Clean up temporary debug code.
8. Summarize cause + fix.
